dialogues.speaker: Nieminen
dialogues.text: With the recent crackdown and all, maybe I should lay low for a while...

dialogues.speaker: Nieminen
dialogues.text: Haven't you heard? The Fatui caught a bunch of treasure hunters breaking into the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau...

dialogues.speaker: Nieminen
dialogues.text: Damn shame, I say. Apparently, the place is full of valuable stuff. Even just a handful of random components from inside would fetch a pretty penny on the open market.

dialogues.speaker: Nieminen
dialogues.text: I take it you've got some experience in this regard? It's worth staking out, that's for sure, but don't go charging in unprepared — the place is crawling with elite Fatui forces.

dialogues.speaker: Nieminen
dialogues.text: You've been inside? How did you get in? I've been staking the place out for ages, and I still haven't found an opening.

dialogues.speaker: Nieminen
dialogues.text: I was starting to consider registering with that Kruchek fella in The Flagship and sneaking in that way, but then I saw the guy with the sign outside and figured I should err on the side of caution.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Heh, all this fuss about the Fatui's stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Nieminen
dialogues.text: I never thought I'd meet someone who wasn't intimidated by the Fatui... Whatever they're guarding, it must be big! Why else would all these treasure hunters be swarming about?

dialogues.speaker: Nieminen
dialogues.text: That said, something huge like that is probably out of reach for someone with my capabilities. On balance, I think I'm better off playing it safe...
